patient_text: It is not recommended to take Norco with Tylenol. They both include Acetaminophen (active ingredient of Tylenol) which increases your risk of an accidental overdose, which can cause severe or permanent damage to the liver. You should only take one of them at a time. Ask your pharmacist for more information.

patient_text: It is not recommended to take more than one product containing Ibuprofen at a time. Taking more than the daily limit raises your risk of stomach bleeding and kidney problems. Ask your pharmacist for more information.

patient_text: More than one of your products contains Diphenhydramine. Taking them together can make you very drowsy and confused, especially if you are over 65. Ask your pharmacist for more information.
